newsitem.title: USA: Air crash in Alaska lake kills three.
newsitem.headline: Air crash in Alaska lake kills three.

text.p: A pilot and his two visiting relatives from Germany were killed when their small plane crashed into a lake in a popular Alaska state park, authorities said on Wednesday.
The Cessna 206 crashed shortly after takeoff on Monday in Kachemak Bay State Park on the Kenai Peninsula about 150 miles (240 km) southwest of Anchorage, state troopers said.
Divers recovered the bodies of the pilot and his two passengers in China Poot Lake late Tuesday after high winds hampered recovery efforts.

Troopers identified the victims as Alain Rieser, 55, owner of Halibut Cove Air in nearby Halibut Cove, and his brother and sister-in-law who were visiting from Germany, Daniel Rieser and Angela Neuke, both 50.
